newsitem.title: GREECE: ECU/DRS STABILITY CALMS GREEK BONDS, MONEY MKTS.
newsitem.headline: ECU/DRS STABILITY CALMS GREEK BONDS, MONEY MKTS.

text.p: Ecu/drachma was trading near the top of its 304.20/60 range in late dealings proping up bonds and floaters and easing long-term implied drachma rates from forex forwards, traders said.

"Ecu/drachma has been on a more stable pattern today and this have made other markets breath a sigh of relief," said a money dealer at a private bank. "Implied drachma rates have even eased in long tenors but short-term rates hold morning levels."
Other dealers said foreign investors stepped in and bought ecu/drachma after selling it above 305 late on Wednesday.
"Some guys have made lots of money by selling ecus above 305 and buying them today at much lower levels," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
Bond dealers said fixed coupon bonds and floaters had recouped some of their early morning losses and attributed that to the stability in ecu/drachma.

"Some investors were selling FRNs and bonds to raise cash for Friday' auction but some others got scared of the bigger than usual volatility in ecu/drachma which was openly encouraged by the central bank," said a bond dealer.

The finance ministry will hold an auction of 250 billion drachmas of seven-year floaters with the first coupon set at 12.40 percent and 120 billion drachma worth of three-year, 10.20 percent coupon bonds on January 24.

"The huge liquidity is the big ally of the finance ministry at tomorrow's auction," said a dealer. "Foreign investors seem hesitant to participate because it has not been clarified how long it is going to take before they get reimbursed for taxes paid or to be paid."

Deputy Finace Minister Nicos Christodoulakis told reporters today that a memorandum clarifying tax reimbursement will be issued after parliament votes in the relative tax law. The law is expected to be voted in this week.
Only dematerialised securities will be auctioned on Friday which resolves the identification issue of any perspective bond holder and the holding time period.
The mark was quoted at 156.45/60 drachmas from Wednesday's 156.600 fix, the dollar at 256.83/08 drachmas from 256.410 and the Ecu at 304.20/30 from 304.250 drachmas.
